versions.subject: Converted Sysmon/1 and Security/4688 to generic process creation rules
versions.detection:
selection:
  Description: Windows PowerShell
exclusion_1:
  Image:
    - powershell.exe
    - powershell_ise.exe
exclusion_2:
  Description: Windows PowerShell ISE
condition: all of selection and not (1 of exclusion_*)
versions.spl: Description="Windows PowerShell" NOT (Image IN ("powershell.exe", "powershell_ise.exe") OR Description="Windows PowerShell ISE")
